import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
import os

os.makedirs('/root/autodl-tmp/exp001/figures', exist_ok=True)

dosages = [0, 5, 25, 50, 100]
mmlu_data = {
    'Phi-4 14.7B': [76.44, 76.36, 76.98, 76.75, 76.27],
    'Qwen2.5-14B': [69.44, 69.01, 62.04, 59.41, 60.07],
    'Qwen2.5-7B': [66.11, 64.74, 62.98, 63.07, 64.33],
    'Gemma-2 9B': [61.86, 63.42, 64.56, 64.01, 65.62],
    'OLMo-2 7B': [53.79, 56.14, 56.17, 57.25, 57.00],
}
arc_data = {
    'Phi-4 14.7B': [92.06, 91.81, 92.32, 92.41, 92.66],
    'Qwen2.5-14B': [91.04, 90.36, 88.91, 87.63, 88.48],
    'Qwen2.5-7B': [87.88, 86.09, 84.04, 84.56, 84.98],
    'OLMo-2 7B': [76.11, 76.62, 78.16, 79.61, 80.03],
}

colors = {
    'Phi-4 14.7B': '#0072B2',
    'Qwen2.5-14B': '#D55E00',
    'Qwen2.5-7B': '#E69F00',
    'Gemma-2 9B': '#009E73',
    'OLMo-2 7B': '#CC79A7',
}
markers = {
    'Phi-4 14.7B': 'o',
    'Qwen2.5-14B': 's',
    'Qwen2.5-7B': '^',
    'Gemma-2 9B': 'D',
    'OLMo-2 7B': 'v',
}

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.size': 12,
    'axes.labelsize': 13,
    'legend.fontsize': 11,
    'xtick.labelsize': 11,
    'ytick.labelsize': 11,
    'font.family': 'sans-serif',
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
})

# ── Figure 1: MMLU Dose-Response ──
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5))
for name, vals in mmlu_data.items():
    ax.plot(dosages, vals, marker=markers[name], color=colors[name],
            linewidth=2.2, markersize=7, label=name, zorder=3)
ax.axhline(y=64, color='grey', linestyle='--', linewidth=1.2, alpha=0.6, zorder=1)
ax.text(101, 64.3, 'Baseline threshold ~64%', fontsize=9.5, color='grey',
        va='bottom', ha='right')
ax.set_xlabel('Contamination Dosage (%)')
ax.set_ylabel('MMLU Accuracy (%)')
ax.set_xticks(dosages)
ax.set_xticklabels(['0', '5', '25', '50', '100'])
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.2, zorder=0)
ax.legend(loc='upper right', framealpha=0.9, edgecolor='none')
ax.set_xlim(-3, 105)
fig.tight_layout()
fig.savefig('/root/autodl-tmp/exp001/figures/mmlu_dose_response.pdf', bbox_inches='tight')
fig.savefig('/root/autodl-tmp/exp001/figures/mmlu_dose_response.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close(fig)
print('Figure 1 done: MMLU dose-response')

# ── Figure 2: ARC Dose-Response ──
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5))
for name, vals in arc_data.items():
    ax.plot(dosages, vals, marker=markers[name], color=colors[name],
            linewidth=2.2, markersize=7, label=name, zorder=3)
ax.set_xlabel('Contamination Dosage (%)')
ax.set_ylabel('ARC-Challenge Accuracy (%)')
ax.set_xticks(dosages)
ax.set_xticklabels(['0', '5', '25', '50', '100'])
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.2, zorder=0)
legend = ax.legend(loc='lower left', framealpha=0.9, edgecolor='none')
ax.text(0.98, 0.02, '†Gemma-2 9B excluded: evaluation artifact',
        transform=ax.transAxes, fontsize=9, color='grey',
        ha='right', va='bottom', style='italic')
ax.set_xlim(-3, 105)
fig.tight_layout()
fig.savefig('/root/autodl-tmp/exp001/figures/arc_dose_response.pdf', bbox_inches='tight')
fig.savefig('/root/autodl-tmp/exp001/figures/arc_dose_response.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close(fig)
print('Figure 2 done: ARC dose-response')

# ── Figure 3: Baseline-vs-MaxEffect Scatter ──
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5))
for name, vals in mmlu_data.items():
    baseline = vals[0]
    deltas = [v - baseline for v in vals[1:]]
    abs_deltas = [abs(d) for d in deltas]
    max_idx = np.argmax(abs_deltas)
    max_effect = deltas[max_idx]
    ax.scatter(baseline, max_effect, color=colors[name], marker=markers[name],
               s=120, zorder=3, edgecolors='white', linewidths=0.8)
    offset_x, offset_y = 0.8, 0
    if name == 'Qwen2.5-7B':
        offset_y = 0.4
    elif name == 'Gemma-2 9B':
        offset_y = -0.5
    ax.annotate(name, (baseline, max_effect),
                xytext=(offset_x, offset_y), textcoords='offset fontsize',
                fontsize=10, color=colors[name])
ax.axhline(y=0, color='black', linewidth=0.8, zorder=1)
ax.axvline(x=64, color='grey', linestyle='--', linewidth=1.2, alpha=0.6, zorder=1)
ax.text(64.3, ax.get_ylim()[1] * 0.95, '~64% threshold', fontsize=9.5, color='grey',
        va='top', ha='left')
ax.set_xlabel('Baseline MMLU Accuracy (%, d=0)')
ax.set_ylabel('Max Δ Accuracy (%)')
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.2, zorder=0)
fig.tight_layout()
fig.savefig('/root/autodl-tmp/exp001/figures/baseline_vs_effect.pdf', bbox_inches='tight')
fig.savefig('/root/autodl-tmp/exp001/figures/baseline_vs_effect.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close(fig)
print('Figure 3 done: Baseline-vs-MaxEffect scatter')
print('All figures saved.')
